name: Final Review & Next Steps
instructions: Thirty days in, you should be able to play the C major scale, several chords, and at least one full song -- real, usable piano skills.
Pick a concrete next step (a new scale, reading music more fluently, a harder song) to keep momentum going.
Consistency beats intensity from here -- even 10-15 minutes a day keeps you improving.
Revisit today's chord series video as a close to the program -- the vocabulary it built is what everything else was based on.
